name: Perfect Prince
source:
Scholar Nicolas receives a letter one day. It is an invitation to the southern seaside country, the Neiapolis Kingdom. The king of the country wants him to become a tutor for the royal prince.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
学者Nicolas有一天收到一封信，那是来自南方海滨国家Neiapolis王国的邀请。该国国王希望他担任王子的家庭教师。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
